In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a liver cell-free protein-synthesis system from rainbow trout has been shown to be capable of initiating de novo synthesis in response to the presence of exogenously supplied synthetic RNA.
the trout liver cell-free protein synthesizing system can initiate de novo translation of protamine mRNA and that this process is not restricted to the testis.
the cell-free system from trout liver can initiate synthesis of protamine from exogenous mRNA, and that the in vitro synthesized protamine is identical with in vivo protamine.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
trout testis histone and protamine can be synthesized in vitro in the presence of a liver cell-free system and that both are initiated at the NH2-terminal.
the in vitro system can initiate de novo the synthesis of both histone and protamine, and the initiation of protamine involves the incorporation of NH2-terminal methionine.
